app.title: AmpliQA
app.summary: A person enters or imports RNA spectrophotometer readings, checks each sample's purity and concentration against protocol limits, and gets the reverse-transcription volumes and a pipetting list. They then plan the qPCR plate and per-gene mix, import the instrument's run files, omit faulty wells, and assign samples to groups with reference genes, a control group and optional primer efficiencies. The interface computes normalized relative expression per sample with blank, replicate and reference-stability checks, recommends and runs the group comparison test, and draws publication bar charts and a heatmap. It ends with a drafted methods-and-results text in two languages, exported as Word files with the figures, and an experiment spreadsheet that carries all inputs to the next session.

task.text: Take a relative gene-expression experiment from RNA quality check through quantification, statistics and figures to a drafted methods-and-results text.

data.text: Per-sample RNA absorbance readings, then per-well threshold cycle values from qPCR instrument exports, tied to samples, genes and experimental groups, with a sample-to-group table and analysis settings.
data.item: a well on a qPCR plate: one sample, one gene, one cycle value

stage.text: analysing a qPCR run after the bench work, from raw cycle values through to the write-up

mechanism.text: A multi-page workflow where each screen reads the shared experiment state left by the previous one: editable tables feed computed status tables, a coloured plate grid and mix tables, then imported wells are curated in an editable table whose omissions and group assignments flow into the expression results, statistics tabs, configurable figures and a live-updating draft text. Everything is saved to and reloaded from one spreadsheet file.

field.text: relative quantification of gene expression by RT-qPCR in molecular biology

workflow.name: compute normalized relative quantities from instrument runs, test groups, and write up

steps.step: check input material against quality criteria and prepare it
steps.here: NanoDrop readings typed or imported; each sample gets a quality and status (ready, dilute, do not use) from A260/280, A260/230 and minimum concentration, plus common-mix totals and a per-tube pipetting list
genes and samples listed one per line become a colour-coded 96-well map with duplicates and blanks per gene block, split across plates if needed, with a per-gene reaction mix
several result files at once, auto-detected as QuantStudio, Rotor-Gene Q or a long/wide table; Rotor-Gene blocks get a suggested gene to confirm and a sample list in well order
tick Omit on faulty wells; optionally drop outlying technical replicates automatically; blanks over a Ct limit and replicate spreads over a max difference are flagged

steps.step: assign items to groups and set the baseline
steps.here: groups from the leading letters of sample codes, editable, with a blank flag and an optional second factor; choose 1–5 reference genes, the control group, group order and per-gene efficiencies

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: efficiency-weighted ΔCt, ΔΔCt and fold change normalized to the geometric mean of references, reference stability (geNorm M, CV), then a recommended test after assumption checks with post hoc and Grubbs outliers
methods, statistics, results and figure legend drafted in English and Portuguese with test values filled in, exported as .docx or a zip with PNG/SVG figures; Prism-ready tables from the results tab

distinctive: normalization to several reference genes by geometric mean, with each reference's stability judged against fixed thresholds
the statistical test is chosen automatically from residual normality and variance checks and the reason is shown, with manual override
blank wells are recognised by name and checked against a cycle limit for contamination
a second experimental factor is normalized per level to its own control, or analysed by two-way ANOVA
the whole experiment round-trips through one spreadsheet file the person keeps, with nothing stored on the server
